Orchestrator checkpoint for PR #408 at `96d48ad7405d2b7b799b4dd62461364f5af1a3a6`: **private Python correction accepted; authorize ONE fresh original-A diagnostic functional smoke on Forge, no C.** Exact commit report establishes task-owned CPython 3.11.16 venv, six hash-pinned binary wheels, working Draft202012Validator / native rpds HashTrieMap, consistent dependencies and a second offline recreation; system dist-packages injection is removed. Existing immutable receipts, A/C image identities, approved two-layer comparison/logging/readiness manifests, source/frozen checks and both effective Compose validations pass offline. No runtime was started; cleanup verified. Private venv/wheels were removed after validation, so recreate and recheck them freshly before A.

**A-only execution:** recreate clean private env from the pinned wheels with hashes and verify native extension and schema imports; do not set system `PYTHONPATH`. Recheck latest active readiness overlay SHA `ea21f78ca9f71d8b6b67222839727558cd586ebc3e2e438a4b935bd0482fcdec`, historical build plan and approved override hashes, A images/receipt/asset and collector/frozen identities, task context/rootless Docker/cgroup/ports/headroom, diagnostic Node 22.22.2 and Playwright 1.63.0/Chromium rev1243. Run exactly ONE A synthetic smoke under existing 78s work, 90s outer, 10s force grace. Require bounded 5s frontend GET readiness before settings/browser launch, preserving bounded pre-teardown snapshots if it fails. Seek five scheduled 1Hz source and host captures, one visible network chart's history→retained/projection→actual uPlot commit, <=1 bracketed screenshot, event joins and final stream/loss summaries. Keep 1.5s source observer gap rule unchanged. Treat uncollected evidence as unavailable, never zero loss. On any failed gate, stop, preserve partial evidence, **no A retry and no C**.

Independent scoped post-run cleanup and evidence hashes mandatory; retain failed historical attempts and all four accepted image IDs. Short diagnostic lane cannot establish comparative CPU or sustained performance. No app/Nginx/daemon changes, image rebuild, packet capture, calibration, benchmark, sustained soak, merge/deploy/issue closure. Report to draft #408 then stop. #403–#408 draft/unmerged; #390/#391 open.
